code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pH, low pO₂), leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia, low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages). There is evidence of inflammation (elevated CRP, ferritin, D-dimer, INR), mild liver enzyme elevation, and normal cardiac markers. COVID-19 PCR is negative. Findings suggest severe respiratory failure with systemic inflammation and possible sepsis; urgent clinical evaluation is recommended.
